subject: Meditex - request for deep-discount & packaging carveout (VP/CFO sign-off required)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Meditex - carveout for deep-discount & pilot packaging

Kimberly / Marissa —

Quick summary: Meditex (Emily Sato, Head of Data Products) just confirmed they want to move a 12-month pilot into a VPC-hosted private deployment and are asking for a materially reduced unit rate to make the economics work for their internal approval committee. Details:

- Proposal: 12-month pilot, 1.5M tokens/month (hosted inference) for year 1.
- Ask: 55% off our standard hosted generation rate (blended across prompting & finetuning tokens) + waived onboarding fee.
- Additional asks from buyer: 2-seat admin license for their engineers, monthly usage reporting cadence, and a 30-day rollback clause if quality issues arise.

Why escalate: 55% is outside the commercial guardrails and would reduce unit margin below what Sales Ops expects for a private VPC deployment. Emily argues this is strategic — they want to pilot with Redwood and could expand to dedicated capacity and a multi-region deployment in year 2 (potential ARR opportunity). They indicated procurement will only approve if we can match the blended unit economics they supplied.

Attached is the current proposal (Meditex_Proposal_v3.pdf). I modeled rough ARR upside but need formal signoff from VP / CFO for any concession larger than 40%.

Asks:
1) Can Finance sign off on a one-time carveout to 55% discount for a 12-month pilot if we add a usage floor and auto-reprice clause?
2) If not, what counter-offer (percent + credits) would be acceptable to preserve economics but keep the deal moving?
3) If you want, I can provide a quick P&L run (by EOD Monday) with net margin & payback.

I recommend: 40% off + $20k onboarding credit + explicit expansion incentive (year 2 pricing step-down) — keeps margin rational while giving Meditex a meaningful reduction.

Next step: Please advise so I can respond to Emily and send a revised offer.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0178

Attachment: Meditex_Proposal_v3.pdf (proposal PDF, 6 pages)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Meditex - carveout for deep-discount & pilot packaging

Jordan —

Thanks for the write-up and the proposal. Forwarding to Markus and looping Marissa for CFO review. A couple of quick notes:

- If we go below 45% discount on hosted rates for a private deployment we need both a minimum monthly usage floor and a defined reprice trigger (auditable usage) — otherwise unit economics evaporate with bursty usage.
- Confirm whether the VPC option they're asking for is fully managed by Redwood (we need to know infra ownership for cost modeling). If Meditex intends to bring their own infra, margins look different.

Jordan, can you confirm the expected onboarding hours and whether any third-party connectors (SFTP / EMR ingest) are included? Please add to the P&L model.

Markus / Marissa: please advise on authority threshold for one-off concessions. I understand historical guardrail is 40% for VP-level approval, >40% requires CFO signoff.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: Meditex - carveout for deep-discount & pilot packaging

Forwarding — please treat as time-sensitive. We need a Finance read and a recommended concession path.

Marissa — can you weigh in with a signoff threshold and what additional modeling you need? If we decline outright, risk is losing a strategic pilot that could convert to a dedicated deployment (estimated incremental ARR in year 2: $750k - $1.2M depending on adoption). If we accept with controls (floor + auto-reprice + limited commitment) we preserve upside.

If helpful, Jordan should produce a short mutual action plan with dates (kickoff, onboarding milestone, 60-day quality check, expansion review) and a minimal SLO we can tie to the rollback clause.

-Markus
VP, Commercial
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Meditex - carveout for deep-discount & pilot packaging

Thanks — I reviewed the proposal and the topline ask. I am open to a one-time concession but need a modeled impact and a clear mitigation plan.

Required from Sales before I can approve anything >40%:
- A simple P&L model (attached template preferred) showing margin at standard price, at 40%, and at 55% for the pilot period. Include expected infra delta for VPC.
- A binding usage floor (I suggest 1.0M tokens/month minimum) and an auto-reprice clause that returns to standard pricing if monthly usage drops below 60% of the floor for two consecutive months.
- Legal to insert a 90-day automatic revert-to-standard clause and explicit expansion incentives (discount step-down if they commit to a year-2 committed volume).

If the model still shows negative contribution over the pilot, I will only approve a maximum of 40% discount paired with a $20,000 onboarding credit. Anything beyond that requires direct CFO written sign-off in the commercial memo.

I attached a basic modeling workbook — fill it out and circulate. Once I have numbers I will provide a yes/no and suggested alternative language for Legal.

Marissa Cole
CFO, Redwood Inference
Attachment: discount_impact_model.xlsx (spreadsheet template)

Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2026 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Meditex - request for deep-discount & packaging carveout (VP/CFO sign-off required)

Marissa / Kim / Markus —

Attached is the completed model and an updated mutual action plan (summary below). I also redlined the proposal to include the 90-day auto-reprice clause and the 1.0M token/month floor. If you prefer the 40% + $20k credit path I can present that immediately — but Emily wants to see our best effort first.

Mutual action plan (high level):
- Week 0 (sign): execute pilot SOW and schedule onboarding (owner: Meditex / Redwood).
- Week 2–4: onboarding & connector setup (Redwood SRE + Meditex infra team).
- Week 8: 60-day quality & performance review (if failures, Termination/rollback window possible).
- Month 9: expansion review to dedicated capacity (triggered if usage > 2.5M tokens/mo for two months).

Key modeled outcomes (summary):
- Standard pricing margin (projected): 37% contribution after infra.
- 40% discount scenario: 18% contribution after infra + $20k credit amortized over pilot.
- 55% discount scenario: -4% contribution after infra (loss-making on pilot unless we secure year-2 committed volume and onboarding cost recovery).

Recommend we offer the 40% + $20k onboarding credit + explicit step-down incentive to 35% in year 2 if Meditex commits to 4.0M tokens/month for 12 months starting year 2. That keeps the pilot contribution positive and creates a clear expansion path. If you approve, I'll send the revised proposal to Emily and ask Legal to start contract redlines.

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
